title: Orchard Beach Nature Center reopened after renovation
summary: NYC Parks' Pelham Bay Park news page records an August 8, 2024 ribbon cutting for the renovated Orchard Beach Nature Center after a $2.35 million reconstruction project.
observed_change: A parks nature-center building at Orchard Beach returned to documented public use after reconstruction, with environmental displays and Urban Park Rangers programming referenced by NYC Parks.
area: Orchard Beach / Pelham Bay Park / Bronx
source_name: NYC Parks Pelham Bay Park news page

architect: NYC Parks and Orchard Beach Nature Center reconstruction project team; design firm not identified in the indexed Parks news item

geometry_source: Approximate point from Orchard Beach Nature Center location at Orchard Beach and Promenade in Pelham Bay Park.
